Jefferson Township Parks (“Parks”) are open to the public daily from sunrise to sunset. Except for activities explicitly approved by the Township, all Parks shall be closed from sunset until sunrise. No person may enter, remain upon, or attempt to access any portion of park property while closed. The Township may temporarily close all or portions of a park due to weather, safety, maintenance, or other operational needs. Visitors must comply with all posted or announced closures and with instructions issued by authorized Township personnel. 1.2 Protection of Property & Natural Resources. Planting areas that divide lanes of traffic are referred to as median or parkway strips.
